general.vista_resumen: Review assignments and check each change before confirming it.
general.ayuda_buscar: Search for a person by name and open their record.
general.ayuda_revisar: Check the profile and reason before confirming a change.
general.ayuda_confirmar: Check the reference shown when the action is complete.
general.ayuda_doble_control: Administration and Intervention changes need approval from another authorised person.
general.buscar_descripcion: Only the details needed to administer profiles are shown.
general.buscar_corto: Enter 2 to 80 characters to find the person.
general.buscar_inicial: Enter a name to start searching.
general.buscar_vacio: No matching people were found. Check the name and try again.
general.buscar_mas: There are more results. Refine the name to find the person.
general.ficha_descripcion: Assignments and history for the selected person.
general.ficha_inicial: Select a person from the results.
general.ficha_sin_perfiles: This person has no profiles that you can view.
general.ficha_sin_historia: There are no visible profile changes in the history.
general.pendientes_descripcion: Proposals for another administrator to review.
general.pendientes_inicial: Proposals will appear after your access is confirmed.
general.pendientes_vacio: There are no pending proposals you can view.
general.pendientes_sin_accion: Another authorised person must decide on this proposal.
general.decision_descripcion: Check the details before confirming. This change will be audited.
general.decision_descripcion_doble: Your proposal will await another administrator's decision.
general.decision_descripcion_cierre: Your decision will close this proposal and be audited.
general.propuesta_confirmada: Proposal recorded. Another administrator must review it.
general.accion_no_disponible: No authorised action is available for this record.
general.lectura_sin_cambio: You can view profiles, but your current access does not allow changes.
general.error_denegado: You cannot access this information. Check your authorisation with IT.
general.error_conflicto: The data has changed. Reopen the record and review the current version before continuing.
general.error_servicio: Profile administration is unavailable. Press Refresh or try again later.
general.error_servicio_dialogo: The change could not be confirmed. Check the connection and press Confirm again. If this continues, check the history.
general.error_solicitud: The decision could not be recorded. Review the record and reason before trying again.
general.error_respuesta: The response does not confirm the change. Check the history before repeating it.
general.error_textos: The text for this page could not be loaded. Refresh the page.
